pokedexEntries.x: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

pokedexEntries.y: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

pokedexEntries.or: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

pokedexEntries.as: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

pokedexEntries.za: It uses loops to gather things it likes and take them to its secret home. It also teleports through a loop.
